gaps_note: No private captures were available for this service; every page is hand-authored from product knowledge (provenance: reference, confidence: medium) rather than extracted from a screenshot. 'Manage resources' is reached from IAM & Admin's 'Manage Resources' nav link (ui-spec/gcp/iam-admin.json marks it external) and from the project picker; it has no org/folder hierarchy to show because Vyomi's GCP lens is project-scoped, so the native tree view is modeled as a flat project list.
